The Supreme Court just ruled pesticide companies can't be sued in state court over cancer warnings on their labels.

We introduced the Pesticide Harm Accountability Act to restore your right to sue pesticide manufacturers in state court if they fail to warn you about the risks of their products. The bill would also force the EPA to identify and address federal barriers blocking these lawsuits.

If a pesticide company's product poisons you, you should be able to take them to court. Period. NO ONE

Every day, our service members stand watch far from everything they love: their families, their friends, and the homes they left behind.

They carry this sacrifice so the rest of us can live in freedom.

“The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me. My heart leaps for joy, and with my song I praise him.” — Psalm 28:7

May God bless our service members, their families, and all who have sacrificed for this country. We owe you everything.

When JFK was president, roughly 1 in 20 American kids were obese. Today, it’s 1 in 5.

This didn’t happen because kids got lazier. It happened because we let ultra-processed foods take over what our children eat every single day.

The MAHA movement is working to bring real food and scratch cooking back into America’s schools. Our kids deserve food to help them grow, learn and thrive.

Make America Healthy Again.
